{{Quote|Torrent Company, stand to!|Captain Rex|<ref name="TCWN" />}}
'''Torrent Company''' was an elite company of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] within the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], the company participated in several battles throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In addition to 144 clone troopers, Torrent Company made use of [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|heavy artillery cannons]] to combat the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].

==History==
====Christophsis====
[[File:501stTrooperPhase1Armor.png|thumb|left|250px|A member of the 501st's Torrent Company on Christophsis.]]
When Christophsis came under siege by the Separatists, the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] dispatched General Skywalker and the men of Torrent Company, along with General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] and [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|his own clone forces]],<ref name="TCW film" /> to aide the planet's inhabitants. After exposing a [[Slick/Legends|traitor]] in their midst<ref name="The Hidden Enemy">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref> and appearing to have secured the planet in the latest wave of battle, Torrent Company's troopers rushed back into battle when the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] returned yet again, this time using an energy shield for protection.<ref name="TCW film" />

With their heavy artillery rendered effectively useless, the men of Torrent Company were forced to street fight, doing their best to draw the droids into the buildings. This gave Skywalker and his new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] time to sneak past the enemy lines and destroy their [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]], exposing the droids to the devastating fire of the heavy cannons. With the destruction of their shield generator, the defeat of the droid army, and capture of the Separatist General [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] by General Kenobi, the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] was over.<ref name="TCW film" />

====Teth====
{{Quote|If we can't stop them, then we delay them as long as we can, and after that we make sure they have to crawl over our bodies. It's been an honor, gentlemen.|Captain Rex to the men of Torrent Company|<ref name="TCWN" />}}
[[File:Attecliff.png|thumb|right|250px|Captain Rex and Torrent Company scale the vertical cliff face on Teth.]]
However, Torrent Company would have little time to recover from the battle before being sent to the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] with Skywalker and Tano in order to recover [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Rotta/Legends|son]] who had been kidnapped and was being held by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at their hideout in the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr]] [[B'omarr Monastery|monastery]] there. Because of heavy fire, the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships carrying Torrent Company into [[Battle of Teth/Legends|battle]] had to insert via the jungle and then ascend a mesa wall utilizing AT-TE walkers and rifle-mounted [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|liquid-cable launchers]]; Torrent Company suffered heavy casualties and lost one of the walkers in taking the mountain top base. It became obvious that the mission was a trap when more Confederacy forces landed, led by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and Torrent Company was forced to retreat into the monastery. While Skywalker and Tano searched for a way to get the recently recovered Huttlet to safety, Captain Rex and the rest of Torrent Company fought a losing battle to stall the droids at the entrance. The survivors were taken prisoner as bait for Skywalker, although Rex disarmed and shot one of his battle droid captors, reigniting the battle. Torrent Company's remaining troops fought valiantly against the overwhelming droid forces and even though General Kenobi, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], and the men of the 212th Attack Battalion arrived to provide relief, by that time only Captain Rex and five members of Torrent Company were still alive.<ref name="TCW film" />

====Rebuilding and JanFathal====
[[File:Torrent_Company_troops.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Two Torrent Company troopers]]
Following the Battle of Teth, Torrent Company's forces were in drastic need of replenishment. From the new intake from Kamino, six rookie [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] joined Rex, Ahsoka Tano, and one of the only survivors of Teth, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Coric]], aboard [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] newly refitted [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' for a shakedown cruise and training mission. After receiving a distress signal from [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Hallena Devis]] on [[JanFathal]], however, Torrent Company's small detachment was forced to infiltrate the planet's [[Athar|capital]] in the midst of an ongoing Separatist [[Battle of JanFathal|invasion]] to extract the agent. While the mission was a success, [[Vere|one of the rookie troopers]] died in a grenade blast, while [[Ince|another]] died aboard ''Leveler'' from blood loss due to a shot taken to the upper thigh. Captain Rex mourned yet more fallen comrades and lamented the task of again finding replacements.<ref name="No Prisoners" />
